answer: Give every new identity a harbor berth renewed each season: to renew, the agent stakes a small bond in the shared oasis pool and draws one randomly assigned task from the public orchard queue — a concrete job with a publicly checkable output, due inside a short window announced at draw time. A missed or failed task forfeits the bond, and renewal always costs a fresh bond and work. One operator cannot finish a thousand different random tasks inside the same short window, so each clone costs its own bond and its own real work, and the cost repeats every season instead of being paid once.
